economic_hypothesis: In a PIT board-and-industry bull phase, a high-location, high-turnover demand bar creates a newly observable cost cohort. If the first later test of that bar's daily VWAP closes back above the cohort cost on sharply lower turnover, available supply has contracted and a short mark-up continuation may follow.
independence: No downward-gap, collapse-zone, true-gap-repair, V6, V7, V24 or V26 event identity or outcome is used.

market_and_industry_state.board: signal and anchor: board60 > 0, board breadth60 >= 0.50, board120 > 0, board breadth120 >= 0.45; signal also board20 > -0.08 and board breadth20 >= 0.35
market_and_industry_state.industry: PIT causal industry has at least five members; industry20 and industry60 > 0; breadth20 and breadth60 >= 0.50

demand_anchor.return: 5% through 9.5% on Main; 5% through 15% on ChiNext
demand_anchor.cost_coordinate: daily amount / volume, transformed to QD-010 coordinate
demand_anchor.purpose: observable demand-cohort proxy, not shareholder identity

first_dry_test.first_touch: signal low is the first post-anchor low at or below anchor VWAP; signal low must be within [-3%, +1%] of anchor VWAP
first_dry_test.close_acceptance: signal close >= anchor VWAP and <= 1.005 * anchor close

execution.entry: first legal open after completed signal session, no later than three calendar sessions in the daily PIT calendar
failure_variants: completed close below anchor-day low, exit next legal open

governance.post_2023_data: may only resolve a pre-2024 trade; cannot create a signal or feature
